title: Kafka failover: East → West
description: Demo-grade Kafka DR: suspends the 3 East brokers (host-level outage), proves the West cluster keeps serving with an RF=3 produce/consume round-trip on a fresh probe topic, measures RTO, then resumes East.

observe.what: direction · suspended brokers · target-served boolean · probe token · RTO seconds · recovery state · timeline (pre-flight → failure-injected → target-healthy → recovery-attempted → source-healthy-again)
no errors; the probe topic is created + RF=3-replicated + the test record produces+consumes through

whatProves: When the East primary cluster is gone (3 brokers suspended), West keeps serving full RF=3 traffic — the Phase 0.H exit-gate posture (observed RTO ~13.20s in v0.5.0, under the 60s master-plan budget). MM2 has been mirroring throughout.
